name: International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence

page_limit_content.note: 正文（含全部图表）上限 7 页；参考文献/致谢/贡献声明/伦理声明另占最多 2 页

evidence.quote: Papers must be no longer than 9 pages in total: 7 pages for the body of the paper (including all figures/tables), plus up to 2 additional pages with references

page_limit_total.note: 总页数上限 9 页（7 正文 + 2 参考文献页）

evidence.quote: Papers must be no longer than 9 pages in total: 7 pages for the body of the paper and 2 pages for references

references_counted.note: 参考文献计入总页数（占专用的 2 页）

evidence.quote: plus up to 2 additional pages with references

camera_ready_extra_pages.note: 录用后可付费加页（最多 2 页，按页收费）

evidence.quote: for accepted papers, up to two additional pages may be purchased at an additional cost per page

paper_size.note: 美式 Letter（8.5in × 11in）；A4 需按规则调整下/右边距

evidence.quote: All measurements assume an 8-1/2" x 11" page size.
Print manuscripts two columns to a page, in the manner in which these instructions are printed.

margins_mm.note: 等效单边页边距：左右 0.75in=19.05mm；上 0.75in=19.05mm；下 1.25in=31.75mm（官方指南明列 .75"/1.25"；sty 用 topmargin=-0.25in + 内置 1in 得 0.75in）

evidence.quote: left and right margins: .75"
gap between columns: .25"
\setlength\textwidth{7.0in}
Use 10-point type in a clear, readable font with 1point leading (10 on 11).

body_font_family.note: 建议使用 Adobe Times Roman（\usepackage{times}）

evidence.quote: For reasons of uniformity, use of Adobe’s Times Roman font is strongly suggested.

anonymity.note: 主赛道双盲；不得含作者名/单位/致谢及 PDF 元数据身份信息；自引用第三人称

evidence.quote: From the authors’ perspective, reviewing for IJCAI 2025 is double-blind.
Submission site : https://cmt3.research.microsoft.com/IJCAI2025

supplementary_policy.value: ≤ 50MB; PDF or ZIP; must be anonymized; reviewers may consult at discretion
supplementary_policy.note: 补充材料上限 50MB、PDF/ZIP、须匿名；审稿人可自行决定是否查阅

evidence.quote: Authors may submit up to 50MB of supplementary material, such as appendices, proofs, derivations, data, or source code; all supplementary material must be in PDF or ZIP format.

checklist_required.note: 投稿时须遵循可复现性指南与 checklist

evidence.quote: Authors must follow the reproducibility guidelines (available here) and checklist at the time of paper submission.

page_numbering.note: 官方 sty 关闭页码与页眉页脚；送审版须加行号

evidence.quote: \thispagestyle{empty}        \pagestyle{empty}

bib_style.note: 官方提供 named.bst：author-year 引用（如 [Gottlob, 1992]）

evidence.quote: % This file implements citations for the ``named'' bibliography style.

title_format.note: 标题 14pt 粗体、Title Case；作者名 12pt 粗体

evidence.quote: Center the title on the entire width of the page in a 14-point bold font.

figure_caption_position.note: 图号与题注位于图下方；题注 9pt

evidence.quote: Captions should always appear below the illustration.

table_caption_position.note: 表格题注同样位于下方

evidence.quote: they should also appear floated to the top (preferably) or bottom of the page, and with the captions below them.

float_placement_rules.value: float to top (preferred) or bottom; wide floats may span both columns when not inline
float_placement_rules.note: 浮动体优先置顶，其次置底；跨栏仅限非行内浮动体

evidence.quote: They should be floated to the top (preferred) or bottom of the page, unless they are an integral part of your narrative flow.

table_style_hint.value: no vertical lines; three horizontal rules (1.5pt top/bottom, 1pt below header); right-align numeric columns

evidence.quote: where there are no vertical lines and only three horizontal ones

algorithm_style_hint.value: algorithms are special floats; caption in header, left-justified between horizontal lines

evidence.quote: their caption should appear in the header, left-justified and enclosed between horizontal lines

equation_style_hint.value: equation numbers same font/size as body (10pt); main symbols ≥ 9pt
equation_style_hint.note: 公式编号与主符号字号

evidence.quote: equation numbers should be typeset with the same font and size than the main text (10pt). Main symbols of the formula should not be smaller than 9pt.

reference_style_hint.value: author-year citations, e.g. [Gottlob, 1992]; references title unnumbered

evidence.quote: Citations within the text should include the author’s last name and the year of publication, for example [Gottlob, 1992].
